query:
SELECT lang, count(*) AS observations, sum(like_count) AS likes,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE contains(lower(body), 'bts')) AS bts_substring_matches
 FROM read_parquet(?) GROUP BY lang ORDER BY lang NULLS LAST
caveats: Only three shards, not full-corpus performance.
Local files may be warm in the operating system cache.
Repeated remote query may reuse DuckDB or network caches.
No Azure database or concurrent-user benchmark was run.
